info.name: Helpcenter Zoho CRM Related Records API API

params.name: parentRecordModule
params.description: The module name of the parent record (e.g., Contacts, Leads, Deals, Accounts, Services__s, Price_Books)

params.name: parentRecord
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent record. Must be a valid numeric record ID.

params.name: relatedList
params.description: The name of the related list (module) containing the records to retrieve or modify

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Field names must follow API naming conventions.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination (starting from 1)

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of records to return per page

params.name: page_token
params.description: Token for fetching the next set of records after 2000. Use the value from 'next_page_token' in the previous response.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of record IDs to retrieve.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order for records.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort records by. Allowed: id, Created_Time, Modified_Time.

params.name: converted
params.description: Filter for converted records.

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of records from a specific related list of a parent record in a CRM module. Supports filtering by fields and conditional requests using If-Modified-Since header.

items.docs: Removes relationships between a parent record and multiple records in a specified related list, identified by their IDs in the query parameter. This operation deletes only the relationship links, not the actual records themselves. The target records remain intact in their respective modules.
